citations.title: Rent agreement — Yenda premises
citations.quote:
RENT AGREEMENT

This agreement is made on 31 March 2026 between Kagne Narayana (the Owner) and Snowdrop Medtech Private Limited (the Tenant) for the premises at H.No 1-15, Yenda, Utnoor, Adilabad 504346.

1. The Tenant shall pay a monthly rent of Rs. 18,500 (Rupees Eighteen Thousand Five Hundred only), payable by the fifth day of each month, excluding electricity and water.

2. The Tenant has paid a refundable security deposit of Rs. 1,11,000, equal to six months' rent.

3. This lease is for eleven months from 1 April 2026 and may be renewed by mutual consent.

4. Either party may end this agreement by giving two months' written notice.

5. The Tenant shall not sublet the premises without the Owner's written consent.
